THE ART OF LOOKING YOUR BEST

Jawed Habib Hair & Beauty Salon in Model Town, Jalandhar brings together skilled stylists, a calm, well-lit space and care that begins with listening. Every cut, colour, treatment and makeover is planned around you, your hair, your skin and the look you want.

From everyday haircuts to bridal makeup, we aim for one thing: that you leave happier with the mirror than when you arrived.
